bio: This plush, elegant eatery in the heart of Pont-de-Vaux can be relied upon to uphold tradition whilst adding a suave modern spin. Scallops with wakame and vichyssoise; crispy sweetbread and green pumpkin; Bresse chicken cooked two ways… The classics are subtly reworked by this seasoned chef, whose score is as delicate as it is original; the menu changes monthly in line with his inspiration and what’s available from the market. The enticing wine list stars a fine selection of burgundies. Slick, professional, cheerful service....
